task: Wave2C GBP analytics and replay privacy boundary repair

claims.criterion: PostHog does not initialize or retain prior identity/content on a sensitive first path
claims.scenario: Render the provider initially at the Google Business Profile settings path with existing PostHog localStorage, sessionStorage, cookie and queued content
claims.observable: init is not called; PostHog storage/cookie/queue content is removed; unrelated storage is preserved

claims.criterion: Navigation into and out of the sensitive boundary is safe
claims.scenario: Initialize on an ordinary screen, navigate into GBP settings, then navigate to ordinary restaurant settings
claims.observable: entry stops replay, resets identity, opts out, disables autocapture/pageleave/replay and switches to memory persistence before paint; exit restores the existing client once without a second init

claims.criterion: Sensitive current and delayed events cannot cross the boundary
claims.scenario: Invoke the configured before_send on the sensitive pathname and with a queued pageleave event referencing a sensitive URL after leaving

claims.criterion: Plausible excludes GBP and dual-sync paths through its supported contract
claims.scenario: Invoke the real next-plausible provider with the layout-exported exclusions
claims.observable: the generated script element receives data-exclude and selects script.exclusions.js; patterns include exact and descendant GBP/dual-sync paths

claims.scenario: Run existing PostHog pageview, analytics dispatch and exception-filter regressions together with the new privacy tests
claims.invocation: vitest run five focused analytics files

claims.scenario: Strict TypeScript, scoped ESLint, Prettier and diff validation
claims.invocation: tsc --noEmit; eslint authorized scope; prettier --check authorized scope; git diff --check
